question: What best describes a dimension table?

description: Correct relationship cardinality

title: data modelling and relationships
description: Why the flat table returned 41,280 riders

title: data modelling and relationships
description: Cross-filter direction default
question: What should the cross-filter direction be set to on a relationship between a dimension and a fact table, by default?

description: Risk of Both cross-filter direction

title: data modelling and relationships
description: Why mark a date table

title: data modelling and relationships
description: Diagnosing a relationship that produces blanks with no error

title: data modelling and relationships

title: dax fundamentals
description: Measure vs calculated column
question: What is the key difference between a calculated column and a measure in Power BI?
options: A calculated column is computed once per row at load time and stored; a measure is computed on demand and stores nothing|A measure is computed once per row at load time; a calculated column is computed on demand|There is no functional difference between them|Calculated columns can only contain numbers
answer: A calculated column is computed once per row at load time and stored; a measure is computed on demand and stores nothing

description: Correct aggregation measure
question: Which DAX expression correctly counts every row in the swiftroute_deliveries table?

answer: COUNTROWS ( swiftroute_deliveries )

title: dax fundamentals
description: Why DIVIDE instead of the slash
question: Why is DIVIDE preferred over the forward slash operator for a ratio measure in DAX?
options: DIVIDE is faster to type|DIVIDE checks for a zero denominator and returns blank instead of an error or Infinity|The slash operator does not exist in DAX|DIVIDE always returns a percentage automatically
answer: DIVIDE checks for a zero denominator and returns blank instead of an error or Infinity

title: dax fundamentals
description: What CALCULATE does
question: What does the CALCULATE function do in a DAX measure?
options: It only performs arithmetic, identically to a calculator|It evaluates an expression after modifying the filter context with the conditions supplied|It converts a measure into a calculated column|It deletes rows that do not match a condition
answer: It evaluates an expression after modifying the filter context with the conditions supplied

title: dax fundamentals
description: Filter context concept
question: In Power BI, what is the filter context of a value shown on a chart?
options: The DAX code used to write the measure|The set of filters, from slicers, rows, and columns, that narrow the data before the measure runs|The colour formatting applied to the visual|The name of the table the measure references
answer: The set of filters, from slicers, rows, and columns, that narrow the data before the measure runs

title: dax fundamentals
description: Reconciling a measure against source
question: A trainee wants to verify that an On-Time Rate measure is correct. What is the recommended first reconciliation step after predicting an expected value?
options: Publish the report and see if anyone complains|Run the measure at the total level with no filters applied and compare it against the prediction|Rewrite the measure using a different function and see if the number changes|Ask an AI assistant if the number looks right
answer: Run the measure at the total level with no filters applied and compare it against the prediction

title: dax fundamentals
description: Blank versus zero
question: In a DAX measure result, what is the difference between a blank and a zero?
options: There is no difference, they mean the same thing|Blank means no rows matched the filter; zero means rows matched but summed to nothing|Blank always indicates an error in the formula|Zero can only occur if DIVIDE is used incorrectly
answer: Blank means no rows matched the filter; zero means rows matched but summed to nothing

title: dax fundamentals
description: Time-intelligence requirement

title: dax fundamentals
description: The reconciliation check that does not need either number in advance

answer: Confirming the two rates sum to 100 percent

title: dax fundamentals
